1.ConclusionText: The heroes hide in their homes for fear of alarming the wild animals.

2.ConclusionText: The heroes think firearms are much more useful than magic. So, they are practicing their shooting skills indoors.

3.ConclusionText: Someone has been secretly rescuing beasts from their captors.

4.ConclusionText: Hunting has become a popular sport. The residents are purchasing firearms and raring to give them a shot.

5.ConclusionText: With the rampant thefts, the residents think they should be actively protect themselves rather than waiting like sitting ducks to be stolen from.

6.ConclusionText: Some heroes' special abilities have been stolen by an unknown force.
6.RewardText: Many heroes have been staying in of late. They had been attacked by a mysterious figure and lost their special abilities as a result. This sounds implausible but might just be the most rational explanation for the incidents. It's said that some special entities can do precisely that, such as certain sorcerers or Hypogeans.

7.ConclusionText: Wanting to go on a sea vacation, the Hypogean contacted a private ship and set sail in secret.

8.ConclusionText: The craftsmen sailed out and lent their skills to the island's construction.

9.ConclusionText: The ship is sailing out to collect fish specimens for the gallery curator.

10.ConclusionText: The Hypogean hired craftsmen to build a palace for himself.

11.ConclusionText: This mysterious structure was built by human craftsmen in secret.

12.ConclusionText: The abilities stolen from the heroes are being kept by the Hypogean in the mysterious gallery.
12.RewardText: A Hypogeans once sneaked into the city and stole the abilities of the heroes through special means. Now, the Hypogean keeps those skills as his collection in that mysterious and dangerous gallery. We must find a way to recover them.

13.ConclusionText: To foster cultural exchange, all the heroes have long ago taught their unique skills to many others.

14.ConclusionText: The enchanted panacea was extremely potent. The heroes have all reclaimed their lost abilities.

15.ConclusionText: A master marketer forms a team to promote the magic potion he has created.

16.ConclusionText: The Hypogean takes human apprentices and gives them an item from his collection as their graduation gift.

17.ConclusionText: Someone has snuck into the gallery and stolen the enchanted panacea.

18.ConclusionText: Acquire items from the gallery's collection to use the heroes' stolen special abilities.
18.RewardText: We have made remarkable progress in the investigation. Someone has entered and stolen an item from the gallery. Shortly after, some of the heroes' stolen abilities were wielded. We can be sure that the stolen powers have been transformed into items of the gallery's collection. Furthermore, they did not lose their abilities even after being removed from the gallery, and those who possess them can use the heroes' stolen skills. This spells danger, but may also bring us new opportunities. We need to deal with this prudently.

19.ConclusionText: Hidden in the vagabonds camp are many experts and masters. They have provided guidance to the thief who has stolen from the gallery.

20.ConclusionText: The thief who stole from the gallery has given the other treasures to the vagabonds.

21.ConclusionText: The vagabonds have figured out a way to combat the Hypogean curator, making him hesitate to retrieve his stolen items.

22.ConclusionText: The Hypogean curator admired the thief's courage and personally instructed him on the proper use of his collected items.

23.ConclusionText: The other treasures have been used to bribe the guards of the gallery. Therefore, the curator is still clueless about the theft.

24.ConclusionText: The gallery houses mysterious forces that can enhance the items.
24.RewardText: As our investigation progressed, we learned more about the collection. Someone has snuck into the gallery and stolen the items that had been manifested from the heroes' abilities. As a result, he was able to wield the unique skills of the heroes. Thanks to other treasures he had acquired from the gallery, such skills of his were also amplified. It appears that he was able to enhance those items after stealing them from the gallery…

25.ConclusionText: The vagabond is a master of the criminal underworld who eliminated bandits and seized their wares.

26.ConclusionText: The vagabond transforms into a success coach and prepares to rake in tons of cash.

27.ConclusionText: The bandit leader is the tycoon's illegitimate son. Having failed miserably at business, he had no choice but to inherit the tycoon's estate.

28.ConclusionText: The bandits found that using brute force to earn money was too slow, so they decided to use their brainpower instead.

29.ConclusionText: Having benefitted from ill-gotten gains, the illegitimate son decided to pass on knowledge as a way of giving back to society.

30.ConclusionText: As the tycoon's illegitimate son, the vagabond inherits all of his assets.
30.RewardText: The bounty hunters received a mission to locate a missing pocket watch. After painstaking investigation, we identified the target. Unfortunately, the elderly tycoon rumored to possess the watch had passed away, leaving his estate to his estranged illegitimate son. We're confident that the watch is now in the hands of this heir.

31.ConclusionText: A gift from the machinist to the tycoon, the pocket watch bears witness to the friendship between the two.

32.ConclusionText: The tycoon invites his friend to see his collection of magical objects.

33.ConclusionText: The machinist rigged the tycoon's coffin with booby traps to protect his remains.

34.ConclusionText: The pocket watch is a magical object that, when worn for long periods of time, maintains the wearer's health.

35.ConclusionText: The tycoon practiced forbidden magic in the hopes of gaining immortality.

36.ConclusionText: The pocket watch was buried with the tycoon and is now at the cemetery.
36.RewardText: We managed to discover the whereabouts of the pocket watch, but unfortunately, it had been buried with the old man as a funeral offering. Curses! How are we supposed to retrieve something from a dead man's coffin? Who's to say whether we could persuade the heir? Otherwise, we might have to take advantage of the night... In any case, let's report our findings to the client first. Perhaps things will take a turn for the better.

37.ConclusionText: The tycoon's "invaluable treasure" is the trade secrets he learned.

38.ConclusionText: The tycoon's "invaluable treasure" is the mother of his illegitimate son.

39.ConclusionText: Love would have only slowed the tycoon's earnings.

40.ConclusionText: The tycoon's pocket watch contains his trade secrets.

41.ConclusionText: The tycoon is actually a woman—the mother of the illegitimate son rather than the father.

42.ConclusionText: The pocket watch contains information about the treasure.
42.RewardText: As it turns out, our client is the heir himself! Now we needn't worry about how to retrieve the watch. According to our agreement, as long as it ends up in the heir's hands, our mission will be completed. However, the client also gave us a new mission, and it seems that the watch must hold some kind of secret, perhaps related to the treasures the old tycoon was rumored to possess...

43.ConclusionText: The writing inside the pocket watch is simply an anti-counterfeiting measure meant to verify its authenticity.

44.ConclusionText: The expensive pocket watch expresses the tycoon's long-held belief that time is money.

45.ConclusionText: Precious materials crafted by a world-class master—the pocket watch itself is the treasure!

46.ConclusionText: The writing inside the pocket watch is merely its date of manufacture, and I guess it must be out of warranty by now.

47.ConclusionText: The tycoon used the pocket watch to convey that skilled craftsmen are the real treasure.

48.ConclusionText: The writing inside the pocket watch records coordinates in the sea, marking the location of the treasure.
48.RewardText: The client acquired the pocket watch, and his subsequent missions confirmed our previous deductions. The watch was so precision-crafted that it could be used for seafaring navigation, and judging from the format of the inscriptions inside, it appears to depict a chart of nautical coordinates. It seems that we now know the location of the treasure.
